tagline: Lightweight PHP and Laravel help desk and shared inbox that runs on shared hosting.
description: FreeScout is a help desk and shared mailbox built with PHP and Laravel, designed as a free alternative to Zendesk and Help Scout. Several agents work on conversations from one or more email mailboxes. It connects by SMTP, IMAP or POP3, supports OAuth sign-in for Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, and has no limit on agents, tickets or mailboxes. Day-to-day tools include internal notes, auto replies, merging and forwarding, collision detection when two people open the same thread, and a progressive web app. The interface is translated into 33 languages. The requirements are modest: a web server, PHP 7.4 or later, and MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL. The project says it will run on shared hosting and states no minimum CPU or RAM. A web installer and updater exist, a Docker image is available, and managed options such as PikaPods and Cloudron are listed. The code is AGPL-3.0. Core features are free. Extras such as WhatsApp, Facebook, Slack, live chat and AI replies come from separate modules, some from third parties. Expect to pay for some of them.
strengths: Unlimited agents, tickets and mailboxes in the free core
Runs on plain PHP and MySQL, MariaDB or PostgreSQL, including shared hosting
Web installer and updater, plus a Docker image and one-click installs
Collision detection, internal notes, merging and forwarding of conversations
Module system and an API, with Zapier and Make integrations
limits: Many channels (WhatsApp, Facebook, live chat) and extras are modules, not part of the core
Community and third-party modules vary in quality and upkeep
No built-in ticket SLA engine or customer portal is described in the README
Email delivery and spam handling rely on your own mail server or provider
The README gives no minimum RAM or CPU figure, so capacity planning for large inboxes is up to you
bestFor: A small support team that already has a mailbox and wants a shared inbox on cheap PHP hosting.
